cluster_unit: task (G = 24 per block); seeds are paired repetitions within a task, not independent clusters
pairing: Same task and seed across every condition of a block; condition order randomized within each task-seed block with Random(1000*task+seed)

inference.primary: Equal-weight task means of paired differences; cluster t interval with G-1 degrees of freedom and exact two-sided sign-flip p over task means
inference.supplementary: Cluster bootstrap (existing clustered_interval) reported alongside, never as the decision interval
inference.multiplicity: One primary endpoint per block; Holm across the primary endpoints of M0 (G0) and V1 in this round
inference.jerk: Primary jerk metrics use a common 0.1 s third-difference step (common_step_jerk, common_step_boundary_jerk); native-step jerk is reported as a secondary high-frequency measure

M0a.question: Why ARDY without correction misses root waypoints by 2.5-3.1 m: text-path conflict, a single sparse waypoint per window, or neither
M0a.tasks: task_geometry.ardy_path_tasks(): 8 body headings x 3 speed profiles, path reverses at 5 s
M0a.endpoint: root waypoint error at registered waypoint frames (mean over windows), correction = 0; contrasts aligned-conflict (sparse) and dense-sparse (aligned)
M0a.stop_rule: If aligned-sparse error stays above 1 m, text conflict is rejected as the main cause; if dense brings correction-off error under 0.5 m, sparse conditioning is the cause and M1 uses dense waypoints

M0c.question: G0: does official ARDY correction raise boundary jerk at realistic correction magnitudes
M0c.tasks: task_geometry.ardy_offset_tasks(): 8 body headings x 3 text schedules (none, reverse at 5 s, reverse at 10 s)
M0c.target: Per window: end root of the same-noise unconstrained prediction plus offset delta along the body-right normal of the task heading
M0c.primary_endpoint: G0 contrast: per task, mean over seeds and offsets {0.1, 0.25, 0.5} of (correction 1 - correction 0) boundary jerk at the 0.1 s step
M0c.gate: G0 passes when the relative increase (mean paired difference / mean correction-0 value) is at least 20% and the cluster t interval excludes 0; otherwise direction A becomes a dose-response report
secondary: dose-response of the same contrast per offset including 1.0 m
root waypoint error and 2/5/10 cm success

V1.question: Is the ~1 m reach error a task-geometry artefact (180 degree heading, unreachable target) rather than a conditioning limit
V1.tasks: task_geometry.reach_tasks(): tiers reachable (0.8 arm), stepping (1.3 arm), legacy (original world targets) x 3 heights x 2 sides, plus 6 mirror cross-body targets
V1.primary_endpoint: MotionLCM control_residual = 1 constrained-wrist error at the target frame on the reachable tier
V1.stop_rule: <= 10 cm: P1 is rewritten as a target-feasibility result; > 20 cm: P1 is restored with the new number; in between: decide with the V1b aligned-text cross
secondary: reachable vs legacy tier error with all guidance off
other-hand distance and chirality on the mirror tier
bone length CV and rigid-refit wrist error for OmniControl spatial

V1b.question: Does target-direction wording change reachable-tier error
V1b.tasks: reachable-tier tasks with low or high targets (4); prompt from task_geometry.reach_direction_prompt

V5.question: Offline recomputation without GPU
items: v2 effects with cluster t interval and sign-flip p
0.1 s jerk for every archived method
PRIMAL and Kimodo raw motions: jerk step, bone length CV, correction magnitude

pilot.M0: Path task 2 (heading 90) and offset task 10 (heading 90, reverse at 5 s), seed 20, every condition; plus exact replays of two archived 20261024 ARDY runs
pilot.V1: Reach tasks reachable-mid-right, legacy-mid-right and mirror-mid-right, seed 20, every condition
pilot.admission: Batch is planned only after pilot_audit.json passes: finite complete outputs, legacy replay bit-identical, frame-0 heading within 20 degrees of body forward, median per-window pre-correction distance to the offset target within 20% of delta, dense mask covering every horizon frame, per-job time within 3x of estimate

conventions_not_derived.offset_levels_m: 0.1/0.25/0.5/1.0 bracket the 0.5 m G0 limit; not derived from a task model
conventions_not_derived.reach_tiers: 0.8 and 1.3 arm lengths from the shoulder, elevations -30/0/+30 degrees; nominal body from 20261024 MotionLCM frame 0
conventions_not_derived.mirror_target: 0.40 m forward, 0.10 m past the midline
conventions_not_derived.root_margin_m: 0.04, the value of the native adapter; success at 5 cm is therefore not independent evidence
conventions_not_derived.gate_threshold: 20% relative boundary-jerk increase, fixed in the 20261030 plan document
